senses.gloss: f.(b. h., v. preced. art.) unclean, levitically impure, forbidden.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:2">Kel. XII, 2</cite> <he>המחובר לט׳ ט׳</he> whatever is attached to an object which is fit to become unclean, may become unclean.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:1">Ib. 1</cite> <he>טבעת אדם ט׳</he> a ring used by man may eventually become unclean; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 7:5">Ḥull. VII, 5</cite> <he>דג ט׳</he> a fish forbidden to eat.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 7:6">Ib. 6</cite> (<cite ref="B00182"><he>בהמה</he></cite>) <he>ט׳</he> a forbidden animal; a. v. fr.—

Ab. Zar. 39ᵃ (referring to ‘the ass of the sea’, v. חֲמָר, a. ‘the ox of the sea’, v. תּוֹרָא) ט׳ טהור טהור ט׳ what is unclean (on land) is clean (in water) &c.—טְמֵא מת = b. h. טָ׳ למת, one made unclean through a corpse.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:8">Kel. XI, 8</cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>טְמֵאֵי מתים</he>, v. supra.
